name: Mask of Servitude (The Blushing Mermaid)
backstory: Mask of Servitude is a dwarven member of Auntie Ethel's flock. She can be found in the The Blushing Mermaid alongside Mask of Vengeance, Mask of Terror, and the real Captain Grisly.
